# Real Couple Photos Folder 📸

Place your high-resolution couple photographs in this folder (e.g. `photo1.jpg`, `photo2.jpg`, etc.) or in `public/images/memories/`.

### Steps to Replace Demo Photos:
1. Copy 6 photos into this folder:
   - `photo1.jpg`
   - `photo2.jpg`
   - `photo3.jpg`
   - `photo4.jpg`
   - `photo5.jpg`
   - `photo6.jpg`
2. Update the `imageUrl` paths in `src/data/memoriesData.ts` to `/photos/photo1.jpg`, etc.
3. Update captions and dates to match your special memories!
